industries.name: Finance / Banking
industries.rationale: Regional phishing and credential-theft campaigns frequently target banks and payment apps across South Asia.

industries.name: Government / NGO
industries.rationale: Spear-phishing and document malware remain common against public sector and aid organizations.

industries.name: Telecom
industries.rationale: Subscriber fraud and SMS-related social engineering remain elevated in the wider region.

industries.name: Builders / Tech
industries.rationale: Supply-chain and developer-tooling abuse (npm/PyPI, CI tokens) is a global pattern affecting startups and freelancers in NP/SA.

industries.name: Healthcare
industries.rationale: Ransomware and data extortion remain a sector risk; volume lower than finance in open reporting.

campaigns.title: South Asia banking credential phishing (sample)

campaigns.title: Malicious package / typosquat targeting developers (sample)
campaigns.summary: Illustrative risk: typosquat packages and post-install beacons. Watch python/node/npm on first-seen unknown destinations.

campaigns.title: Malicious office docs aimed at gov/NGO staff (sample)
campaigns.summary: Illustrative: macro-enabled documents. Local exposure is low unless office apps call unexpected hosts.
